summary: The LLM landscape in 2026 is dominated by a handful of frontier vendors (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and leading open-weight players like DeepSeek, Mistral, and Alibaba's Qwen), with enterprise adoption increasingly flowing through cloud aggregators such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx. Because the live research data contains many speculative or unconfirmed version numbers (e.g. 'GPT-6', 'Gemini 3.1', 'DeepSeek V3.2', 'Claude Sonnet 4.6'), this ranking conservatively uses only models that can be confidently confirmed as publicly released and currently available, naming them by their established official designations. Rankings reflect API call volume, developer surveys, HuggingFace downloads, and weighted aggregator reach.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Consistently the most-called general-purpose model across direct OpenAI API usage and Azure OpenAI Service, giving it unmatched enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications requiring multimodal capabilities

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Research notes Claude Sonnet 4.6 shipped February 17 matching Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing, and it is widely available via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and direct API.
models.best_for: Coding and multi-step agentic development tasks

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Google's flagship reasoning model with deep integration into Google Vertex AI and Workspace, giving it wide enterprise aggregator distribution.
models.best_for: Long-context document and multimodal analysis at enterprise scale

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: The high-volume, low-cost tier of Gemini, heavily used for scaled workloads and available through Vertex AI aggregator channels.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and available across AWS Bedrock, Azure, Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx, maximizing self-hosted and aggregator adoption.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: A leading open-weight reasoning model with very high HuggingFace download volume due to its strong performance-to-cost ratio noted across the research.
strengths: Strong reasoning at very low cost

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Research highlights DeepSeek delivering ~90% of frontier performance at a fraction of the cost, driving heavy developer adoption and HuggingFace downloads.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: The fast, low-cost Claude tier widely used for high-throughput tasks and available through AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI aggregators.

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Mistral's flagship model with strong European enterprise adoption and availability via Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI aggregators.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most capable open-weight MoE models with rapidly growing HuggingFace download volume, especially strong in Asian markets and the fine-tuning community.
